name: Nova Kovács
location: Geartown — industrial district of chop shops and fabricators, near Milwaukee and North Ave
description:
Ngaire Arai-Ofori-Atta are tall and loose-limbed, moving with the deliberate economy of someone who has trained every motion. At 31, there's something unfinished about their face, like a sculpture the artist walked away from — striking rather than beautiful. The chrome is visible — internal drug synthesizer — produces combat stims and medical compounds on deman — and they make no effort to hide it.

Military training — one of the private security corps that folded during the consolidation wars — left them with skills and night terrors in equal measure. They work as a sniper out of Geartown, taking contracts that match their skills and their risk tolerance, which are higher than most people consider healthy.

Ngaire Arai-Ofori-Atta have built a reputation on reliability rather than flash — they show up, they deliver, they collect.

core_fears: Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
That their reputation is built on luck, not skill, and the luck is finite
Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
core_desires: A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
Power — enough leverage that nobody ever threatens them again
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
coping_mechanisms: Connection — finds someone to talk to, even if it's a bartender or a cat
Violence — hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
blind_spots: Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
psychology.secret: Ngaire Arai-Ofori-Atta can't read. Hides it behind voice interfaces and memorization. The shame is older than the chrome.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Flat affect, monotone delivery. The content is terrifying but the voice never rises.
speech_patterns.cadence: Low and even — the vocal equivalent of still water.
verbal_tics: Uses 'we' instead of 'I' — either royal or dissociative, nobody asks
Calls everyone 'friend' — the warmth varies from genuine to threatening
example_lines: "Patience is the weapon. The rifle is just the delivery system."
"At this distance, the target is already dead. They just don't know it yet."
"One shot, one outcome. Everything else is theater."

story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive offers Ngaire Arai-Ofori-Atta a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
A crew member from Ngaire Arai-Ofori-Atta's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
Ngaire Arai-Ofori-Atta discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
narrative_function: As a sniper, Ngaire Arai-Ofori-Atta embodies the tension between independence and isolation. They are a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Internal drug synthesizer — produces combat stims and medical compounds on demand. Retractable monofilament whip in left forearm — concealed weapon, devastating in close quarters
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.

weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions
trust issues that limit crew effectiveness
poor impulse control in specific triggers

decision_rules: Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Takes a specific route home every time, varying only one block per trip — paranoia as lifestyle
breaking_points: Running out of options — no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out
Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity

physical_description.heritage: Complex diaspora blend: primary ancestry from Hispanic/Latin American (21.7%), Eastern European (20.8%), and East Asian (18.6%) regions, with significant contributions from Southeast Asian (15.1%), Northern European (12.8%), and Sub-Saharan African (11.0%) lineages. This creates a striking pan-global phenotype — angular facial structure from Eastern European stock, warm golden-brown undertones from Latin American and African heritage, with subtle East Asian eye shape and cheekbone prominence.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with ropy muscle definition — the build of someone who trains for precision and endurance rather than mass. Low body fat, visible shoulder and forearm musculature from repetitive rifle work and weapon maintenance.
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, functional braid or wrapped low at the base of the skull
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-bronze with subtle olive undertones — the layered complexity of multi-regional ancestry. Slight ashen quality consistent with nocturnal lifestyle has muted natural vibrancy, but underlying warmth remains visible on cheekbones and neck.
physical_description.complexion: Sharp, high cheekbones with subtle East Asian contour, squared jaw with Eastern European angularity, and hollow temples. Skin is clear but marked by the exhaustion of circadian inversion — faint dark crescents under eyes. Clean-shaven or minimal facial hair. Expression typically neutral, eyes tracking environments with predatory awareness. Subtle warmth in skin tone visible despite fatigue, suggesting genetic resilience to circadian disruption.
distinguishing_marks: Thin scar running from left temple to jaw line — clean surgical appearance, likely from injury or augmentation surgery
Faint burn marks on right forearm and wrist — heat scarring from rifle handling and stim-synthesizer thermal venting
Subtle tattoo along the inside of left forearm: a vertical line of small geometric marks in dark ink, possibly a personal tally or military unit designation
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome visible at the left inner forearm where the drug synthesizer system interfaces with the skin — metallic sheen visible under the epidermis with faint LED indicator lights (amber/red) that pulse with synthesizer activity. Left hand shows microscopic tool marks and reinforced joint articulation from monofilament whip housing. No visible cybernetic eyes or limbs.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate, economical efficiency — no wasted motion. Shoulders slightly forward, spine straight. When stationary, weight shifts subtly between feet as if constantly ready to move. Head movement is controlled, eyes scanning in practiced patterns. Hands remain visible and relaxed unless in high-stress situations. Walking gait is smooth and measured, heel-to-toe placement that minimizes sound.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 practical utilitarian — form-fitted tactical cargo pants in dark gray or black, reinforced at knees and ankles. Fitted long-sleeve compression shirt or tactical undershirt to conceal and protect augmentation sites. Heavy insulated jacket or modular body armor overlay in matte charcoal. Worn synthetic boots with good ankle support and grip soles. Minimal jewelry except for a functional watch (analog, not networked) and a single silver ring on right hand. Everything is clean but not new — maintained rather than flashy. No corporate logos, no obvious gang colors.
